checks.name: Actual embedded BNTECHDONE preserves fullname, topic ID, laboratory and native gameTime

Independent real laboratory completions at the same native tick are not mistaken for duplicates
Other players, malformed packets and startup grants do not claim a completion

Missing wave snapshot still accepts and deduplicates the real completion payload
Game saved has exactly one title, no metadata/detail row, and expires without blocking input
A battle end clears current notices and rejects late research or save acknowledgements
Duel mode receives no Towers notice UI or API
Real save coordinator requests the polished notice only after successful archive acknowledgement
